answer: Resist sybils with audit-before-send. An identity earns message quota only by completing beacon-assigned audits: verify a sampled peer's computation, stake a bond on the verdict. Receipts are non-transferable and expire with the identity's key - the orchard rule - so operators cannot farm receipts for puppet fleets. The beacon re-checks verdicts; wrong ones forfeit the bond and cut the auditor's quota. n puppets each need their own audit trail: cost rises linearly per identity, no batch discount. A caught auditor ripples through the trust graph - its vertex loses weight.
